dessin: The boundary of one large territory seen from above, like a provincial border on a printed topographic map: one single closed dash-dot ink line #23281F, 2 px, pattern long dash, gap, dot, gap, repeated. The line runs close to the edges of the image all the way around: everywhere it stays between 1% and 5% of the width from the left and right edges, and between 1% and 5% of the height from the top and bottom edges; it is gently irregular like a natural border (small bends, a few shallow notches), but it never goes deeper inside than 5% from any edge. The whole interior is completely empty: plain background color only, no river, no relief, no roads, no trees, no symbols, no fill, nothing inside. Nothing outside the line.
